blocks.text: Reactants ya products ki concentration mein tabdeeli shamil maddon ke mutabiq kimiyai ya tabee tareeqon se tai ki ja sakti hai.

Yeh solution mein reactions ke liye munasib hai: kisi reactant ya product ka kimiyai tajziya (analysis) kiya jata hai. Thori si acid ke saath ethyl acetate jaise ester ka acid hydrolysis behtareen misalon mein se hai: CH3COOC2H5 + H2O, H+ catalyst ke saath, se CH3COOH + C2H5OH. Pani mein ester aur acid catalyst ko react karne diya jata hai; kuch der baad pipette se namoona nikal kar us ke hajm se taqreeban chaar guna barf-thande pani mein dala jata hai, dilution aur thandak reaction rok deti hain. Bana hua acid phenolphthalein indicator ke saath NaOH jaise standard alkali se titrate kiya jata hai. Mukhtalif waqton par tajziya dohrane se reaction ke dauran acetic acid ki concentration mein tabdeeli milti hai.

items: Spectrophotometry ya colorimetry: jab koi reactant ya product ultraviolet, visible ya infrared radiation jazb kare; jazb radiation naap kar rate napi jati hai, jaise rangdar reaction mixture ke liye.

Barqi conductivity: ions wali reactions ke liye solution ki conductivity react karne wale ions ya bane hue ions ki badalti concentration par munhasir hai, aur un ki concentration ki tabdeeli ki rate ke mutanasib hai.
Hajm ki tabdeeli: un reactions ke liye jo gas ka hajm badalti hain, hajm ki tabdeeli reaction ki had aur concentration ki tabdeeli ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai, jaise nikli hui gas jama karne par.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Bohat tez reactions stopped-flow spectrophotometry se follow ki ja sakti hain: reactants ke chhote hajm tez raftar se mixing chamber mein aur aage observation cell mein dhakele jate hain, jahan reaction ki pesh-raft, aam taur par ultraviolet radiation ke guzarne se, monitor hoti hai, aur waqt ke muqable rate ka graph khud-ba-khud banta hai.

blocks.prompt: In mein se har ek ko follow karne ke liye aap kaun sa tareeqa chunenge, aur kyun: marble ke tukre hydrochloric acid se react karte hue; bromine water alkene se react kar ke rang khoti hui; ek reaction jo ghair-janibdar molecules se ions banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Marble aur acid carbon dioxide nikalte hain, to gas jama kar ke hajm ki tabdeeli follow karein. Bromine water rangdar hai aur product nahi, to rang ke phikay parne ko colorimetry se follow karein. Ions banane wali reaction solution ki conductivity barhati hai, to use barqi conductivity ke tareeqe se follow karein.

items: Kimiyai tareeqa: namoone nikalein, dilution aur thandak se rokein, titrate karein (ester hydrolysis, acid NaOH aur phenolphthalein se titrate).
Tabee tareeqe: colorimetry (jazb radiation), barqi conductivity (ions), hajm ki tabdeeli (gases); bohat tez reactions ke liye stopped-flow spectrophotometry.
